findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok HIGH, AGY HIGH. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. The N6/N7/prefix repair is covered only by the offline mock kit (register.test.ts, 55 tests). The pre-repair code (content head 93969e7a3) WAS loaded live by the operator on 2026-10-30 (status line, over-budget advisor toast, /route-ledger table, background Agent joins, advisor_call receipts attributed to the right agent, 36 schema-valid rows), but nothing ran the repaired head: GATES_PRE_AUDIT.txt lists the live session as NOT_RUN. Operator step: `claude --plugin-dir plugins/dopemux-route-ledger --setting-sources user` with `.control-tower/state` present; one pinned advisor-calling child, then one clean pinned child (expect `advisor 1 · child 1/0 ⚠` for both), one unpinned Agent call (an 8 s toast with no doubled prefix), then `/route` and `/route-ledger receipts`.

findings.title: receiptDir is not checked for symlinks; an explicit absolute directory is allowed; a trailing slash on the default value skips the state check.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok MEDIUM, AGY MEDIUM. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:729-737 (initSession): hasDotDot, empty/root and, for the default, exists(STATE_DIR) are checked; $.fs.stat is never called, so a symlink at or under an explicit receiptDir is followed. AGY adds: line 733 compares the RAW config with DEFAULT_RECEIPT_DIR while line 729 trims trailing separators, so `.control-tower/state/route-ledger/` is treated as an explicit directory and is created on first write even where `.control-tower/state` is absent. Absolute explicit directories are allowed by design (disclosed limitation vii). Accept as a risk or repair (stat or realpath check; compare the trimmed value) and re-audit.

findings.title: Closed receipt segments stay in memory for the process lifetime.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok MEDIUM, AGY MEDIUM. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:634-649 (currentSegment) pushes each new segment onto s.segments and nothing evicts a closed one; rehydrate (:758-795) loads every matching file; lastMainStep (:512-521) scans all segments. Memory grows linearly with receipts. Accept as a risk or evict closed segments after a successful flush.

findings.title: A failed final flush at session.end loses the dirty tail.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok MEDIUM, AGY MEDIUM. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:653-664 (flushSegments) counts a failed write and leaves the segment dirty; the session.end handler schedules one flush and awaits the chain once, with no retry, so receipts still dirty after a failed final write are lost when the process ends. The ` · receipts ✗` status shows the failure only while the session runs. Accept as a risk or retry once at session.end.

findings.title: After /clear, receipts keep going to the pre-clear session file.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok LOW, AGY MEDIUM. Adjudication: CONFIRMED (by design, disclosed). The session.end handler returns next(e) untouched for reason `clear`, and no session.start follows a /clear, so s.sessionId and s.fileStem are never refreshed (disclosed limitation v). Severity DISAGREEMENT: Grok LOW, AGY MEDIUM; R2 rated it MEDIUM; the union keeps MEDIUM. Accept as a documented behaviour, or rotate the stem if the host exposes a new session id.

findings.title: The `main` row of /route-ledger stays UNKNOWN when receipts are disabled (AGY only).
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only. Severity: Grok -, AGY MEDIUM. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:685-695 (commit) pushes a receipt onto s.segments only when s.receiptsEnabled; lastMainStep (:512-521) reads only s.segments; tally (:375-389) does not keep main-loop steps (agent_id null) in s.agents; routeTable (:533-546) takes the main row from lastMainStep. With receipts off (for example no `.control-tower/state`) the main row therefore shows UNKNOWN for requested, observed, effort and match even after main steps ran. No test combines main-loop steps with disabled receipts: the only disabled-receipts command test checks the `receipts` argument (register.test.ts:1138-1144) and the all-UNKNOWN main row at :1068 is for an empty ledger. Auditor severity MEDIUM kept; the coordinator's view is LOW in practice: ` · ledger off` is shown in the status, the agent rows and advisor counts are unaffected, no data is lost. Accept, or keep the last main step outside the receipt segments.

findings.title: The debounce test advances 1000 ms for a 500 ms debounce.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok LOW, AGY LOW. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.test.ts:290 `const DEBOUNCE_MS = 1_000` and :242 advances it; register.tsx:41 `STATUS_DEBOUNCE_MS = 500`: a regression up to 1000 ms would still pass. Accept, or advance by the production constant.

findings.title: The Agent call description (up to 80 characters) is recorded unredacted.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors. Severity: Grok LOW, AGY LOW. Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:915 slices `e.description` to DESCRIPTION_MAX (80, :37); it is written into agent_request receipts and the unpinned toast; the prompt itself is never recorded (disclosed limitation viii). Accept as documented.

findings.title: An empty-string effort or advisor id would violate the schema's minLength 1 (AGY only).
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only. Severity: Grok -, AGY LOW. Adjudication: CONFIRMED (code path); whether the engine ever sends an empty string is UNKNOWN. register.tsx:913 and :957 accept any string effort (including ""); toBindingFields (:274-276) turns it into selection.effort and effort_requested "" while receipt.schema.json requires minLength 1 at both; noteStep (:944) accepts any string advisor id while advisor_use_id requires minLength 1 (verified in the schema). Accept, or reject empty strings with text() as for the model.

findings.title: After a hot reload the toast-once state is not restored (AGY only); a second claim about unjoined step receipts is not a defect.
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only. Severity: Grok -, AGY LOW. Adjudication: CONFIRMED for the toast state; the second claim is NOT A DEFECT. (a) toastOnce (:463-464) keeps its keys in s.toasted; rehydrate (:758-795) and initSession do not repopulate it and the module state restarts on a hot reload, so an advisor call after the reload can toast an already-exceeded budget again: a repeat toast, nothing lost. (b) tally (:377-384) creates a record with requestedModel null for a step of an agent whose request was never joined. That behaviour is accurately described, but it is not a defect in the coordinator's reading: a step receipt's requested_model is the engine's per-step model, not the Agent call's alias, so adopting it would make `match` trivially yes; UNKNOWN is the honest cell for an unjoined agent. Accept the repeat toast, or persist toast keys in the receipts.
